name: invoice-preview
title: Invoice Preview
description: 发票预览：抬头、明细、税费、合计和二维码占位。金额用 Intl.NumberFormat，并带打印样式。

files.content:
"use client" import { cn } from "@/lib/cn" export interface InvoiceLine { description: string quantity: number price: number } export interface InvoicePreviewProps { title?: string number?: string from?: string to?: string lines?: InvoiceLine[] taxRate?: number currency?: string locale?: string className?: string } const DEFAULT_LINES: InvoiceLine[] = [ { description: "界面组件授权", quantity: 1, price: 1280 }, { description: "落地页搭建", quantity: 2, price: 860 }, ] function cellsFor(seed: string) { let hash = 2166136261 for (const char of seed) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ char.charCodeAt(0), 16777619) return Array.from({ length: 21 * 21 }, (_, index) => { const row = Math.floor(index / 21) const column = index % 21 const finder = (row < 7 && column < 7) || (row < 7 && column > 13) || (row > 13 && column < 7) hash = Math.imul(hash ^ (hash >>> 13), 1274126177) return finder || (hash >>> 0) % 3 === 0 }) } function InvoicePreview({ title = "发票", number = "INV-2026-014", from = "效果界面工作室", to = "北窗设计", lines = DEFAULT_LINES, taxRate = 0.06, currency = "CNY", locale = "zh-CN", className, }: InvoicePreviewProps) { const money = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency }) const subtotal = lines.reduce((sum, line) => sum + line.quantity * line.price, 0) const tax = subtotal * taxRate const total = subtotal + tax const cells = cellsFor(number) return (

{title}

{number}

{cells.map((on, index) => ( ))}

开具方 {from}

接收方 {to}

{lines.map((line) => ( ))}
项目 数量 金额
{line.description} {line.quantity} {money.format(line.quantity * line.price)}
小计
{money.format(subtotal)}
税费 {Math.round(taxRate * 100)}%
{money.format(tax)}
合计
{money.format(total)}
) } export { InvoicePreview }
